evidence.quote: The dark mass set up a shout, and rushed forward.
A dark mass of figures could be seen below, making ready for the last rush
One afternoon the fight had been long and exhausting.

adjudications.reason: In the revision, 'The dark mass set up a shout' has no antecedent, because the sentence introducing the massed figures below was cut. The cut of 'One afternoon the fight had been long and exhausting' also lets the habitual game ('generally ended at dark') slide straight into 'the battle' without marking one specific episode. Both lines are needed for the essential snowball scene, and restoring them is cheap.

evidence.quote: named Louisa Catherine, after her Johnson grandmother
He had not a thought but repulsion for it; and yet the picture had another side.

adjudications.reason: The Johnson link is supplied by 004, where Louisa Catherine is named after 'her Johnson grandmother.' The contrast is still signalled by 'yet the picture had another side' and 'not sure that he enjoyed the Boston world most.' Restoring the grandmother and aunt lines would deepen the passage, but it costs 28 words that the target cannot absorb without cutting essential material.

evidence.quote: was sure to be on hand wherever a mob was expected
had been more or less at home there ever since it was built

adjudications.reason: The mob line, 'sure to be on hand wherever a mob was expected,' does not claim he took part in a mob. 'More or less at home' keeps a hedge in the White House line. 'Raggedness of a new kind' still implies a contrast with older raggedness. These cuts are legitimate compression, not factual distortion.

evidence.quote: He had only to repeat what he was told--that George Washington stood alone.
Luckily Charles Francis Adams never preached and was singularly free from cant.

adjudications.reason: The essentials require only that the father did not preach, and that line survives. 'George Washington stood alone' remains in paragraph 10, so the Pole Star formula is intact. Losing the coda is an artistic tradeoff that the word budget cannot cover.

evidence.quote: this education would have been not only good, but quite the best.
He found himself unable to give a sure answer.

adjudications.reason: The plan allows condensing the West argument. The reversal survives in 'quite the best' set against the old man's hedged year-1 judgment and V8. The muting is a permitted tradeoff.
